hero.subhead: Tell Ace what's wrong — by voice or text. You get a clear next step, and when a clinician is what you need, a licensed one who's online in your state takes your visit with your story already in front of them.

stats.label: to tell your story, not forms

howItWorks.headline: Ask. Triage. Connect.
howItWorks.subhead: Three steps from "something's wrong" to a clinician who already knows what you said.

steps.title: Ask
steps.subtitle: Talk or type
steps.description: Tell Ace what's going on in your own words. It asks the follow-ups a good clinician would, skips what doesn't apply, and stops when it has enough.

steps.title: Triage
steps.subtitle: A clear next step
steps.description: You get a suggested next step — self-care, a telehealth visit, same-day care, or 911 — with a plain-language reason and a safety net. Emergencies go straight to 911, never to a queue.

steps.title: Connect
steps.subtitle: A clinician who's online now
steps.description: For anything short of an emergency, request a clinician. Licensed clinicians online in your state see your brief — plan first, then the details — and the first to accept calls you. Ace checks back in two days later.

features.headline: Built so no one starts from zero.

rows.title: A conversation, not a form
rows.description: The intake follows your answers the way a good triage conversation would. Chronic history triggers targeted follow-ups; simple concerns move quickly. No one answers questions that don't apply to them.

rows.title: Only clinicians licensed where you are
rows.description: You tell us the state you're in. Only clinicians licensed there — and set to take your level of concern — can see or accept your visit. The system won't let anyone cross that line.

rows.title: The note is drafted before the call
rows.description: The clinician opens a draft brief built from your words: the plan first, then assessment, what to check, and your history. They review it, edit it, and decide. Ace doesn't diagnose, order, or prescribe.

rows.title: Private by design
rows.description: Encrypted in transit, role-based access, two-step verification for clinicians, an append-only record of who viewed what. We're building toward full HIPAA-ready infrastructure ahead of general availability — and we'll tell you exactly where we stand.

providers.subhead: Set your states and the acuity you'll accept. When a patient in your state needs you, you get a text, open a brief that's already written, call them, decide, and mark it complete. No clinic, no schedule, no front desk.

benefits.text: Draft note waiting before you pick up the phone — plan first, then the rest
Only patients in states where you're licensed, only acuity you've opted into
Emergencies routed to 911 before they reach any queue
Ace follows up at 48 hours and flags you if they get worse

patients.body: Tell Ace what's going on. Get a next step in minutes, and a licensed clinician on the phone when that's what you need.

clinicians.body: Pick your states, pick your acuity, take visits when you want to. The brief is written before you call.
